items.title: OpenAI turned ChatGPT into an ad business
items.oneliner: OpenAI says ChatGPT Ads hit $1B annualized revenue in under 200 days. The AI interface is now ad inventory.

items.title: Fermion shipped a fast local speech model
items.oneliner: Fermion's Phonon-1 transcribes one hour in 2.5 minutes on a laptop. Local speech stacks just got practical.

items.title: OpenClaw 2.0 added memory and swarms
items.oneliner: OpenClaw 2.0 ships memory, Swarm, and Fleet modes, but breaking migrations mean agent platforms are still unstable.

items.title: Omarchy exposed a root escalation path
items.oneliner: Omarchy's default Docker setup let any user process become root. Agent sandboxes fail fast when Docker group equals sudo.

items.title: IIS to SYSTEM escalation hit AD CS
items.oneliner: Researchers showed IIS AppPool can reach NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM via AD CS RPC. Windows identity boundaries are thinner than teams assume.

items.title: A phone accessory spots hidden cameras
items.oneliner: KAIST's $7 SweepLED reportedly finds hidden cameras with 94% accuracy in under five seconds. Privacy tech is becoming consumer-grade.

items.title: AI crawlers are hammering kernel infrastructure
items.oneliner: kernel.org maintainers say AI crawlers are burning CPU on git pages. The scraping tax is now an infrastructure problem.

items.title: AI demand turned Macs into compute gear
items.oneliner: OpenAI reportedly bought tens of thousands of Macs as Apple faced AI-driven shortages. Even training adjacencies are hitting hardware limits.

items.title: Hebbian launched robotics data pipeline tooling
items.oneliner: Hebbian's HFlow targets robotics data quality with multimodal pipelines and drift checks. Physical AI is finally getting data engineering.

items.title: Agent memory got proposed as a file format
items.oneliner: Memoryfield treats agent memory as portable markdown plus indexes, not framework glue. Interoperability may beat another memory stack.
